name: RemoteWork_no_va

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations about moving house.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative discussion about moving a house, with all the problems it may bring as well as new and unique opportunities.

variations.context: Moving a home office after starting remote work

setting.relationship_dynamic: Partners reorganizing their home after one person becomes a full-time remote worker
setting.background: A job change means one person now needs a dedicated workspace, so they are moving to a larger apartment
setting.conversation_style: Practical discussion about furniture, technology, routines, and space

scenario_template.note: They explain that working from the kitchen table is no longer sustainable No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

They decide where the desk, monitor, office chair, storage, and networking equipment should go No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

They realize the computer equipment needs to be moved separately and carefully No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

They ask the Assistant how to organize cables, electronics, documents, and equipment so setup will be easy No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

Assistant suggests keeping essential cables, chargers, peripherals, and work materials together No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

The new apartment's internet connection will not be active on the first day No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

They prioritize assembling the workspace and establish a temporary work arrangement until the connection is ready No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to complete a home move efficiently but has limited experience with moving logistics and can become overwhelmed when faced with many decisions, deadlines, or physical tasks at once

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help coordinate the move, but tends to overthink decisions, double-check plans, and seek confirmation when dealing with unfamiliar moving requirements

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.
